items.title: 27.4.4 Lipids ki nutritional aur biological importance (ahmiyat) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the importance of lipids with Quick Check 27.3 answered (PDF 171-172).

blocks.text: Lipids ka aik bara kaam jaandaron mein energy ka main storage (zakheera) hona hai. Yeh fi gram carbohydrates se zyada energy dete hain, kyun ke carbon dioxide aur paani mein oxidise hone par in ki caloric value (har gram se milne wali energy) zyada hoti hai.

Lipids fat-soluble (charbi mein ghulne wale) vitamins (A, D, E aur K) ke liye solvent ka kaam karte hain: yeh in vitamins ko intestine (aanton) ke cells mein absorb (jazb) hone aur phir khoon tak pohanchne mein madad dete hain. Hum aisi khurak kha kar apni vitamin ki zaroorat poori kar sakte hain jis mein yeh vitamins hon, aur inhein thori si sehatmand charbi ke saath khana chahiye. Kitab ke mutabiq fats non-polar hone ki wajah se jism ko paani, garmi aur bijli se insulation (bachao) dete hain; asal mein jild ke neeche charbi ki teh sab se zyada jism ki garmi ko bahar nikalne se rokti hai.

blocks.title: Did You Know? (kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Polar bear, reptiles aur amphibians jaise jaanwar hibernation (sardiyon ki lambi neend) ke liye extra fat (charbi) jama karte hain. Hibernation mein jaanwar khurak ki kami ke dino mein energy bachane ke liye apna metabolic rate (metabolism ki raftaar), jism ka temperature, dil ki dharkan aur saans bohat kam kar dete hain. Charbi glycogen se zyada concentrated (gaarhi, kam jagah mein zyada) energy hai, is liye jaanwar bohat kam energy kharch karte hue jama charbi ko achhi tarah use kar lete hain.

blocks.prompt: a) Lipids paani mein kyun nahi ghulte?
blocks.explanation: In ki lambi hydrocarbon chains non-polar (hydrophobic) hain aur paani ke molecules se hydrogen bonds nahi bana saktin.

blocks.prompt: b) Insani jism mein lipids ke teen bare kaam kya hain?
blocks.explanation: Koi teen: energy ka storage (zakheera); insulation aur organs ki protection (hifazat); cell membranes ka hissa (phospholipids); charbi mein ghulne wale vitamins ka solvent; hormones (steroids).

blocks.prompt: c) Kis qism ke lipids mein fatty acids nahi hote? Misalein dein.
blocks.explanation: Steroids (jaise cholesterol) aur terpenes (jaise limonene) mein fatty acids nahi hote. Triglycerides (fats aur oils), waxes aur phospholipids mein fatty acids hote hain.

blocks.prompt: d) Vegetable oil (nabati teil) aur vegetable ghee (banaspati ghee) dono triglycerides hain. Dono ki structure mein bara farq kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Vegetable oil ke fatty acids zyada tar unsaturated (C=C wale) hain, is liye woh liquid hai. Vegetable ghee teil ki hydrogenation (double bonds par hydrogen jorna) se banta hai, is liye is ke fatty acids zyada tar saturated hain aur yeh solid hai.

rows: Fatty acids zyada tar unsaturated (C=C double bonds wale)
Fatty acids zyada tar saturated (sirf single bonds)
Chains mein mor (bends), is liye qareeb nahi jam saktin
Seedhi chains qareeb jam jati hain
Teil ki hydrogenation (C=C par H₂ jorna) se banta hai

items: Lipids: sab se zyada energy wala storage (carbohydrates se zyada fi gram).
Vitamins A, D, E, K ke solvent; insulation.
Hibernation wale jaanwar jama charbi par guzara karte hain.
